activity.overview: Research one grassroots campaign for civil rights and write an informative report on its goals, participants, strategies and results.
activity.prompt: Choose one grassroots campaign for civil rights from 1945 to 1970, for example the Montgomery bus boycott, the Greensboro sit-ins, the Freedom Rides, the Birmingham campaign, Freedom Summer, the Selma to Montgomery marches, the Mendez v. Westminster school case, or the Delano grape strike. Research it in at least two authoritative sources. Write an informative report that explains its goals, the organizers and ordinary people who took part, their strategy, the opposition they faced, and the results. End by explaining how the campaign's significance is understood today and whether that has changed over time.
activity.subject: history-social-studies
activity.title: A Movement of Many
